In [[Four-dimensional space|four-dimensional]] [[Euclidean geometry]], the '''cantitruncated 24-cell honeycomb''' is a uniform space-filling [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]. It can be seen as a [[cantitruncation]] of the regular [[24-cell honeycomb]], containing [[truncated tesseract]], [[cantitruncated 24-cell]], and [[tetrahedral prism]] cells. 

== Alternate names==
* Cantellated icositetrachoric tetracomb/honeycomb
* Great rhombated icositetrachoric tetracomb (gricot)
* Great prismatodisicositetrachoric tetracomb
